Title: Echoes Of Earth
Body (HTML):
Nature’s Rhythm — Limited Edition Wearable Art

Born from Rashmi Rao’s original artwork from her Nature’s Rhythm solo exhibition, Echoes of Earth reflects the quiet depth and organic beauty of nature through layered tones of green and gold. The original artwork unfolds through fluid ink movements and organic, cell-like patterns, evoking the interconnected rhythms found within the natural world. Its grounding palette and flowing forms speak to release, renewal, and the gentle unfolding of spring—a moment when nature awakens, transforms, and begins again. Through Rhytara, this artwork is translated onto soft, flowing georgette satin, allowing its organic patterns and earthy tones to move gracefully with the wearer. The fluid drape creates a delicate balance between stillness and movement, echoing the natural rhythm at the heart of the original work. Echoes of Earth is part of Rhytara’s Limited Edition Collection, with only 250 pieces created and made available worldwide for this design. Each piece is produced as a collectible expression of the original artwork.
